name: Gradle
preferTypedApi: The untyped generic task is unable to resolve the Gradle wrapper from a working directory you provide it. The typed API can do this, however; so its usage is preferred and encouraged.
help: Gradle is the open source build system of choice for Kotlin, Java, and Android developers; offering an extensive range of DSLs to configure the build process, as well as plugins to augment various functionalities and provide new ones.

tasks.help: Invoke any Gradle task, by name. Capable of using the Gradle Wrapper in the working directory.

properties.name: Task
properties.help: The fully formed Gradle task string or strings to invoke.

logging.name: DebugLogging
logging.help: Sets log level to debug. Includes the normal stacktrace.

logging.name: InfoLogging
logging.help: Sets the log level to info.

logging.name: WarnLogging
logging.help: Sets the log level to warn.

logging.name: Stacktrace
logging.help: Prints the stacktrace for all exceptions.

logging.name: FullStacktrace
logging.help: Prints the full (very verbose) stacktrace for all exceptions.

console.name: Console
console.help: Specifies which type of console output to generate. Default value is <c>auto</c>.

console.name: ConsoleUnicode
console.help: Specifies which character types are allowed in the console output. Default value is <c>auto</c>.

configuration.name: IncludeBuild
configuration.help: Run the build as a composite, including the specified build.

configuration.name: GradleUserHome
configuration.help: Specifies the Gradle user home directory. Default is <c>~/.gradle</c>.

configuration.name: ProjectDir
configuration.help: Specifies the start directory for Gradle. Default is the current directory.

configuration.name: ProjectCacheDir
configuration.help: Specifies the project-specific cache directory. Default is <c>.gradle</c> in the root project directory.

configuration.name: Offline
configuration.help: Runs the build without accessing network resources.

configuration.name: ProjectProperties
configuration.help: The property values to pass to the Gradle invocation, for access within the build script.

configuration.name: SystemProperties
configuration.help: The JVM system properties to invoke Gradle with.

execution.name: ContinueOnTaskFailure
execution.help: Continues task execution after a task failure.

execution.name: NoContinueOnTaskFailure
execution.help: Stops task execution after a task failure.

execution.name: DryRun
execution.help: Runs the build with all task actions disabled. Use this to show the chain of tasks that would have executed.

execution.name: ExcludedTasks
execution.help: Specifies a task to exclude from execution.

performance_values.name: MaxWorkers
performance_values.help: Configures the maximum number of concurrent workers Gradle is allowed to use.

performance_values.name: Priority
performance_values.help: Specifies the scheduling priority for the Gradle daemon and all processes launched by it. Default value is <c>normal</c>.

performance_flags.name: BuildCache
performance_flags.help: Enables the Gradle build cache. Gradle will try to reuse outputs from previous builds.

performance_flags.name: ConfigurationCache
performance_flags.help: Enables the configuration cache. Gradle will try to reuse the build configuration from previous builds.

performance_flags.name: ConfigureOnDemand
performance_flags.help: Configures necessary projects only. Gradle will attempt to reduce configuration time for large multi-project builds. [incubating]

performance_flags.name: NoConfigureOnDemand
performance_flags.help: Disables the use of configuration on demand. [incubating]

performance_flags.name: IsolatedProjects
performance_flags.help: Enables Isolated Projects. Projects are configured in parallel. Implies --configuration-cache. [incubating]

performance_flags.name: Parallel
performance_flags.help: Builds projects in parallel. Gradle will attempt to determine the optimal number of executor threads to use.

performance_flags.name: WatchFileSystem
performance_flags.help: Enables file system watching. Reuses file system data for subsequent builds.

daemon.name: Daemon
daemon.help: Uses the Gradle daemon to run the build. Starts the daemon if it is not running.

daemon.name: NoDaemon
daemon.help: Runs the build without the Gradle daemon. Useful occasionally if you have configured Gradle to always run with the daemon by default.

daemon.name: StopDaemon
daemon.help: Stops the Gradle daemon if it is running.

daemon.name: ForegroundDaemon
daemon.help: Starts the Gradle daemon in the foreground.
